name: second-brain-monorepo
description: SecondBrain: a self-hosted second brain (tasks, calendar, projects, finance) over a Git-backed Markdown vault, with a 3D refuge UI and isolated AI agents via MCP.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix dashboard ci && npm --prefix service ci && npm --prefix mcp ci && npm --prefix launcher ci
scripts.test:api: npm --prefix service test && npm --prefix mcp test && npm --prefix launcher test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.checkjs.json && npm --prefix dashboard run typecheck

author: Paúl Jaramillo
